lessons.lesson: 每日文章 · 2026-10-02 · AI at Work

words.example: These tools can write emails, translate documents and even plan meetings, saving people a lot of time.

words.example: Another problem is that some workers worry about losing their jobs.

words.example: In the end, people who are willing to learn will always find a place in the workplace.

words.example: Hong Kong is famous for its long working hours.

words.example: First, working too much can harm our health.

words.example: Some even suffer from back pain or headaches, making it hard for them to concentrate.

words.example: Some even suffer from back pain or headaches, making it hard for them to concentrate.

lessons.lesson: 每日文章 · 2026-10-03 · Studying While Working

words.example: I work full-time at a logistics company, so I take an evening English course twice a week.
words.example_zh: 我喺一間物流公司做全職，所以一個禮拜上兩晚英文夜校。

words.example: The biggest challenge is time.
words.example_zh: 最大嘅挑戰係時間。

words.example: I also have to look after my two children, leaving me very little free time.
words.example_zh: 我仲要照顧兩個仔女，令我得返好少空閒時間。

words.example: Sometimes I did not finish my homework on time, and I felt like giving up.
words.example_zh: 有時我冇準時做完功課，真係好想放棄。

words.example: However, I have learned to manage my time better.
words.example_zh: 不過，我已經學識更好噉管理時間。

words.example: I keep revising vocabulary on my phone while I am on the MTR, and I listen to English podcasts when I cook.
words.example_zh: 我搭港鐵嗰陣會不停用手機溫生字，煮飯嗰陣就聽英文 podcast。

words.example: My classmates also make me feel less alone because we share notes and encourage each other.
words.example_zh: 我啲同學都令我冇咁孤單，因為我哋會分享筆記，互相鼓勵。

words.example: Studying has brought me many benefits.
words.example_zh: 讀書帶咗好多好處畀我。

words.example: I can now write simple emails in English by myself, and my manager has noticed my progress.
words.example_zh: 而家我可以自己用英文寫簡單電郵，我上司都留意到我嘅進步。

words.example: Although progress is slow, every small step counts.
words.example_zh: 雖然進步得慢，但係每一小步都有用。

words.example: My children are proud of me, and they have started to read more at home too.
words.example_zh: 我啲仔女都以我為傲，佢哋喺屋企都開始多咗閱讀。

words.example: Successful learners usually possess the character of being patient.

words.example: Hong Kong has one of the best public transport systems in the world.

words.example: The MTR is usually fast, clean and very reliable for daily travel.
words.example_zh: 港鐵平時出街通常又快、又乾淨、又好可靠。

words.example: Many office workers prefer taking the train because it helps them avoid traffic jams.

words.example: Although carriages are often crowded in rush hour, passengers do not usually wait long for another train.

words.example: Buses and minibuses also play an important role in our daily lives.

words.example: Buses cover many areas that the MTR does not reach, letting people travel to more distant districts.
words.example_zh: 巴士覆蓋好多港鐵去唔到嘅地方，畀人去到更遠嘅區。
